restaurantName: Caprice at Crowne Plaza Reading East
address: Wharfedale Road, Winnersh Triangle, Reading, Berkshire,RG41 5TS
bio: Serving modern British and authentic Indian dishes in new 2 AA Rosette Caprice Restaurant and Monty's Lounge Bar, Crowne Plaza Reading East is the perfect place to enjoy Afternoon Tea and while away the day.  Afternoon Tea is served inside the Caprice Restaurant & Monty’s Bar/Lounge or, on warmer days, guests can enjoy creative cocktails overlooking beautiful landscaped podium grounds.  Indulge yourself with mouth-watering scones, elegant finger sandwiches, delicious homemade cakes and freshly brewed tea or coffee. If you are looking to treat yourself, why not add a chilled glass of Champagne, cocktail or jug of Pimm's to the occasion.  Located within close proximity of the M4, Reading and Bracknell, Crowne Plaza Reading East is well placed for London on both the 'Reading to Waterloo' and 'Reading to Paddington' rail services.
pageTitle: Caprice at Crowne Plaza Reading East
